verified_facts.text: The hotel is located directly in the pedestrianized Piazza Santa Maria Novella in Florence's historic center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hotel Minerva is a 4-star superior luxury hotel in the Florence historic center, located directly in Piazza Santa Maria Novella.

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands next to the facade of Santa Maria Novella.
verified_facts.excerpt: wake up next to the façade of Santa Maria Novella

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 350 metres from Santa Maria Novella station and a 6-minute walk from the Duomo.
verified_facts.excerpt: the property is located **350 metres from Santa Maria Novella station** and a **6-minute walk from the Duomo**

verified_facts.text: A bar with a swimming pool sits on the very top of the palazzo, with a 360-degree view of the city and monuments.
verified_facts.excerpt: A bar with a swimming pool on the very top of a Thirteenth Century Palazzo, with a 360-degree view of the city and monuments.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool is heated.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking the pedestrian piazza, guests can take in vistas of Giotto's Bell Tower and the Duomo alongside a heated rooftop pool.

verified_facts.text: The building began as housing for the monks of Santa Maria Novella over seven hundred years ago.
verified_facts.excerpt: The building began as housing for the monks of Santa Maria Novella over seven-hundred-years ago

verified_facts.text: The palazzo was converted into an inn for travelers in 1848.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hospitality came around in 1848, when the palazzo was converted into an “Inn” for travelers

verified_facts.text: Scarpa left a few rooms unaltered, with frescoes and original hand-painted ancient wooden beams that still exist today.
verified_facts.excerpt: leaving unaltered only a few rooms, with beautiful frescoes and original hand-painted ancient wooden beams that still exist today

verified_facts.text: A window frame Carlo Scarpa designed for the hotel is identical to the frames he created for the Uffizi Gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: A defining architectural element is the customized window frame designed by Carlo Scarpa in 1958, identical to the frames he created for the Uffizi Gallery.

verified_facts.text: A mural by Fluxus artist Giuseppe Chiari covers the walls of the breakfast room.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Giuseppe Chiari**, Florentine painter and composer, musician and visual artist exponent of the Fluxus movement, covering all the walls of our breakfast room

verified_facts.text: Sculptures by Emilio Greco are in the main lobby and common areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: | **Emilio Greco** | Sculptor and illustrator; 20th-century sculpture | Main lobby and common areas |

verified_facts.text: Futurist and metaphysical sketches by Carlo Carra are in select suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: | **Carlo Carrà** | Futurist and metaphysical sketches | Select luxury suites |

verified_facts.text: Guests can use an art map to explore the art across public areas and rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can navigate the property's artistic works across public areas and rooms using a dedicated art map.

verified_facts.text: Unique Rooms such as Suite 103 feature preserved 18th-century frescoes and high ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unique Rooms such as Suite 103 feature preserved 18th-century frescoes and high ceilings

verified_facts.text: Most windows frame a view of Florence, the Duomo or the Cloisters of Santa Maria Novella.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most of our windows frame a stunning view of Florence, the Duomo or the Cloisters of Santa Maria Novella.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have soundproofed windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: framing the Florence Duomo, Giotto’s Bell Tower, and the cloisters of Santa Maria Novella through soundproofed windows

verified_facts.text: Accommodation ranges from intimate rooms with a view to duplex suites and spacious family solutions.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the most intimate rooms with a view, to duplex suites, to spacious family solutions.

verified_facts.text: The hotel provides children's kits, welcome gifts and a Kids' Concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The property also provides soundproofed family suites, dedicated children's kits, welcome gifts, and a specialized Kids' Concierge.

verified_facts.text: The Minerva Family Discovery program includes an art-focused scavenger hunt for children.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel offers the Minerva Family Discovery program, which includes an art-focused scavenger hunt designed to engage children with the city's Renaissance heritage.

verified_facts.text: Guests have complimentary access to the fitness centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Fitness Centre:** Complimentary access for all hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is available in the car-free pedestrian zone.

verified_facts.text: Free high-speed fibre Wi-Fi is available in all guest rooms and public areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: **Free High-Speed Fibre Wi-Fi:** Accessible in all guest rooms and public areas.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a certified member of Locali Storici d'Italia.

verified_facts.text: La Buona Novella is the hotel's street-level restaurant with a summer terrace on the piazza, serving elevated regional classics.
verified_facts.excerpt: On street level, with a summer terrace on the piazza, is La Buona Novella, the hotel’s gourmet options where chef Edoardo Papiani whips up elevated versions of regional classics

verified_facts.text: Scarpa's ground-floor breakfast room, with his original chairs, has been left virtually untouched.
verified_facts.excerpt: Scarpa’s ground floor space—pale sea green with a jazzy monochrome floor and his original chairs—has been left virtually untouched

verified_facts.text: Marble bathrooms are supplied with Lorenzo Villoresi products.
verified_facts.excerpt: The contemporary marble bathrooms are supplied with local perfume guru Lorenzo Villoresi’s classy products.

verified_facts.text: Off-site activities include leather workshops with a local artisan, pizza-making classes and a perfume experience with Aquaflor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off-site activities include leather workshops with a local artisan, pizza-making classes and a perfume experience creating personal fragrances with celebrated Florentine perfumier Aquaflor.
